metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Weapons
metas.description: When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Bring Her Back
metas.description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · The Sheep Detectives
metas.description: Every night a shepherd reads aloud a murder mystery, pretending his sheep can understand. When he is found dead, the sheep realize at once that it was a murder and think they know everything about how to go about solving it.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2025 · The Secret Agent
metas.description: Amid the political turmoil of Brazil in 1977, a technology expert is forced into hiding and seeks help from the underground resistance as he tries to flee the country with his young son.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · It Was Just an Accident
metas.description: An unassuming mechanic is reminded of his time in an Iranian prison when he encounters a man he suspects to be his sadistic jailhouse captor. Panicked, he rounds up a few of his fellow ex-prisoners to confirm the man's identity.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2025 · Rekhachithram
metas.description: Suspended cop Vivek Gopinath rejoins after gambling scandal. Tasked with solving 40-year-old murder case with faceless victim, he seeks redemption by cracking the long-unsolved mystery.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Baramulla
metas.description: A police officer investigating missing children cases discovers disturbing truths while supernatural occurrences threaten his family and Baramulla's tranquility.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Eleven
metas.description: A brave and skilled officer with a strong record of solving tough cases is assigned to a new, more challenging serial killing investigation.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Eko
metas.description: In misty Kaattukunnu hills, an elderly woman and her caretaker confront past memories while a hunted dog breeder named Kuriyachan eludes capture. As searchers arrive, buried secrets emerge.

metas.name: ★ 9.1 · 2025 · Unpaarvayil
metas.description: When tragedy strikes twice, Bhavya refuses to remain a victim. Visually impaired, she is drawn into a perilous hunt for the truth behind the mysterious deaths of her husband & twin sister - uncovering a dark world where nothing is as it seems.
